overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long KTOS Daily Target ETF (KTUP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS), less fees and expenses, through derivatives such as swap agreements. KTUP was launched on Sep 16, 2025 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
